name: trellis-init-provenance-gap
title: Fifty-nine tracked platform files lack any integrity receipt and the gitignore allowlist is fragile
description: 59 tracked platform-dot-dir files are uncovered by the union of both existing receipts (.sd-ai-command-pack/provenance.json, 202 files verified clean; .trellis/.template-hashes.json, 116 tracked platform paths). Classify the remainder, decide an integrity mechanism for positively-identified Trellis output, and defend the fragile .claude gitignore allowlist against trellis init re-runs. The .claude tracking asymmetry is settled policy (2026-08-04 decision) and stays closed; the unreceipted .agents copy of trellis-update-spec and the trellis-start orphan get dispositions.
